mapper.insert: INSERT INTO units (building_id, unit_number, floor, area, type, status) VALUES (#{buildingId}, #{unitNumber}, #{floor}, #{area}, #{type}, #{status})

UPDATE units SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
